title: A Categorical Approach to Nilspace Theory
summary: Originating in ergodic structure theory, nilspace theory is concerned with the study of cubical spaces. A first key result in this theory, the weak structure theorem, is the representation of a concrete fibrant compact cubespace as a tower of its canonical truncations, exhibiting each step over the previous one as a principal bundle by a compact abelian group. We present a categorical proof of the weak structure theorem by systematically interpreting the relevant concepts in an appropriate context.
